name: Jiangxi Qiyunshan Food Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Qiyunshan Food Co., Ltd. operates as a fruit snacks company that primarily sells hog plum and other food products in China. The company's flagship product is the hog plum paste available in nine flavors with three additional variations, being low-sugar, reduced sugar and additive-free. It also produces hog plum pellets in two flavors, hog plum soft candy, hog plum gel, hog plum, and other fruit and vegetable pastes including oranges, green plum, loquat and Chinese water chestnut. Additionally, the company engages in provided branding and marketing services to Qiyunshan Oil Tea in respect of its camellia oil products.
